title: Stem cell variations
medium: Stem cell time lapse photography has been divided into layers, re animated and animated independently. There are 7 layers and the length of the originating loo is much longer than previous pieces, this is the first piece that is close to infinite in time as far as repetition. The cells are "paramedic" stem cells bringing dead cells back to life. Software on computer. Edition of 8 with 2 APs.
